reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, is it really tested. At $24.99 for the first box, with money back if I don't like it, I'd try one box. The pre-counted sachets suit me on work trips.
objection: A lab report on a page doesn't prove the box in my hand is the same thing, and I don't know yet if magnesium will do anything for my sleep.
